# Notre Dame Sites

> > Notre Dame Sites is the University of Notre Dame's official WordPress platform for faculty, staff, and students to create and manage web content.

This platform provides a managed WordPress hosting service with regular updates, security patches, and community guidelines. It serves the Notre Dame community with tools for academic, administrative, and research web presence while maintaining university standards for responsible use and content policies.

## Key Topics

- WordPress platform
- University of Notre Dame
- WordPress updates and releases
- Block themes and editors
- Security and maintenance
- Usage guidelines and policies
- Academic freedom
- Copyright policy
- Community support
- Responsible Use of Technologies
- Content management
- University Communications
- WordPress Codex
- User eligibility

## Platform Guidelines and Policies

- [Guidelines For Use](https://sites.nd.edu/guidelines-for-use): Usage guidelines for Notre Dame's WordPress platform and community policies
- [Feedback](https://sites.nd.edu/about/feedback): Feedback form for Notre Dame Sites platform suggestions and requests

- [WordPress Updated to 5.4 "Adderley"](https://sites.nd.edu/blog/2020/04/wordpress-updated-to-5-4-adderley): WordPress 5.4 Adderley release with block editor and accessibility updates
- [WordPress Updated to 5.3.2](https://sites.nd.edu/blog/2020/01/wordpress-updated-to-5-3-2): WordPress 5.3.2 maintenance release with bug fixes announcement
